elle.design: Quick thread 9 noticed the new Model Run panel moves keyboard focus when streaming starts. Feels jarring for keyboard users. Anyone seen this? kevin.eng: Yep, that's intentional to draw attention to live output but agree it can be disruptive. We programmatically focus the results container on first chunk. maya.a11y: Avoid forced focus. Pattern: leave user's focus, announce via an aria-live region (polite), and provide an explicit focusable control to jump. sam.pm: Concern: if we don't move focus, keyboard-only users might miss that results are ready. How do we balance discoverability with non-interruption? kevin.eng: Proposal: show a small inline banner in the results header that is keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0 or a button). No automatic focus. Banner includes count and a "Jump to results" button. elle.design: Agree. Visual needs strong contrast and clear affordance. Copy should be short. maya.a11y: Checklist suggestion: - No automatic focus transfers unless user-initiated. - Use a single off-screen aria-live region with aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true". - Debounce live announcements for streaming (700ms). - Provide explicit, focusable "Jump to results (n)" control; include count in accessible label. - Ensure :focus-visible meets 3:1 contrast on all themes. kevin.eng: CSS example for focus-visible ring: ```css .jump-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent-600); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; } ``` maya.a11y: For the live region we should reuse one node: `
`; populate with a short summary like "3 new results available. Press Jump to results." Avoid long sentences. elle.design: Shorter copy suggestion: "3 new results — press Jump" (we'll decide keyboard shortcut mention later). sam.pm: Shortcut idea: support "J" for jump when results are present. Must be discoverable via the banner and docs. Also ensure no conflict with existing app shortcuts. kevin.eng: Streaming edge: we get partial items continuously. We'll debounce announcements and only update the count in the banner until the stream finishes. maya.a11y: Debounce length: ~700ms after last chunk. Announce once per burst. Otherwise NVDA/VoiceOver will spam. Also set aria-atomic so SRs read full summary. elle.design: UI nit: in dark theme the current banner text uses token `text-muted` which fails 4.5:1. Need to switch to `text-normal` or lighten background. maya.a11y: Prefer updating text to `text-normal` for consistency across toasts. Confirm both in high-contrast and default themes. aria-bot: Updated checklist: live-region-single-node, debounce-700ms, focusable-jump-control, focus-visible-contrast, banner-copy-short. :white_check_mark: kevin.eng: I'll prototype a minimal HTML/CSS/JS widget and add a PR with testing notes. Target: no programmatic focus, keyboard-accessible jump, aria-live summary. elle.design: When Jump button is focused, aria-label should include count e.g. "Jump to results (3)" so screen reader users get context. maya.a11y: Also consider `aria-pressed` if Jump toggles a pinned view; otherwise role=button + aria-label is fine. sam.pm: Test plan: NVDA+Firefox, VoiceOver+Safari, keyboard-only walkthrough, and long-stream stress test. Add test checklist to PR template. kevin.eng: Will ping @maya.a11y and @elle.design on PR and include a small demo page for manual testing. elle.design: Thanks all, appreciate the nuance here. kevin.eng: Posting draft PR link shortly. aria-bot: Reminder: add accessibility notes to release checklist and mark as a11y-blocker if not resolved before launch. :spiral_calendar: elle.design: :thumbsup:
